<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$out = '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/ceypay-payment-gateway/SMOKE_AJAX.txt';
$L = array(); $fail = 0;
function flush_log($out,$L,$fail){ file_put_contents($out, implode("\n",$L)."\nAJAX_STATUS=".($fail===0?'ALL_PASS':"FAILURES_$fail")."\n"); }

// wp_send_json() calls a bare die() outside an AJAX context, which would kill
// the process instead of raising something catchable. Force the AJAX path (the
// real one for these handlers) so wp_die() becomes filterable, then convert it
// into an exception so each rejection can be asserted.
add_filter('wp_doing_ajax', '__return_true');
$thrower = function(){ return function( $message = '', $title = '', $args = array() ) { throw new \RuntimeException('wp_die'); }; };
add_filter('wp_die_handler', $thrower);
add_filter('wp_die_ajax_handler', $thrower);
add_filter('wp_die_json_handler', $thrower);

update_option('woocommerce_currency','LKR');
update_option('woocommerce_ceypay_settings', array('enabled'=>'yes','testmode'=>'no','merchant_id'=>'test-merchant-0001','show_branding'=>'no'));

$order = wc_create_order();
$order->set_currency('LKR');
$order->update_meta_data('_ceypay_transaction_id','txn-belongs-to-this-order');
$order->save();
$order_id = $order->get_id();
$order_key = $order->get_order_key();
$L[] = "order=$order_id";
flush_log($out,$L,$fail);

$other = wc_create_order();
$other->set_currency('LKR');
$other->save();
$L[] = 'other_order=' . $other->get_id();

// A refund shares the order ID space but is a WC_Order_Refund, which has no
// get_order_key(). Passing its ID must be rejected, not fatal.
$order->set_total(100);
$order->save();
$refund = wc_create_refund(array('order_id' => $order_id, 'amount' => 1, 'reason' => 'ownership test'));
$refund_id = ( $refund && ! is_wp_error($refund) ) ? $refund->get_id() : 0;
$L[] = 'refund=' . $refund_id;

$gateways = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways();
$gw = $gateways['ceypay'];
$m = new ReflectionMethod('WC_Gateway_CeyPay','get_verified_order');
$m->setAccessible(true);

// Each case: label, $_POST payload, whether it SHOULD resolve to an order.
$cases = array(
  array('valid order key resolves',      array('order_id'=>$order_id,'order_key'=>$order_key),              true),
  array('forged order key rejected',     array('order_id'=>$order_id,'order_key'=>'wc_order_forged0000'),   false),
  array('missing order key rejected',    array('order_id'=>$order_id),                                      false),
  array('nonexistent order id rejected', array('order_id'=>999999,'order_key'=>$order_key),                 false),
  array('other order key rejected',      array('order_id'=>$order_id,'order_key'=>$other->get_order_key()), false),
  array('empty order id rejected',       array('order_id'=>0,'order_key'=>$order_key),                      false),
  array('refund id rejected',            array('order_id'=>$refund_id,'order_key'=>$order_key),             false),
  array('refund id + own key rejected',  array('order_id'=>$refund_id,'order_key'=>'wc_order_whatever00'),  false)
);

foreach ( $cases as $c ) {
  list($label,$post,$should_resolve) = $c;
  $_POST = $post;
  $resolved = false; $err = '';
  try { $o = $m->invoke($gw); $resolved = ( $o instanceof WC_Order ); }
  catch (\Throwable $e) { $err = get_class($e); }
  $ok = ( $resolved === $should_resolve );
  if ( ! $ok ) { $fail++; }
  $L[] = ($ok?'PASS ':'FAIL ') . $label;
  flush_log($out,$L,$fail);
}

flush_log($out,$L,$fail);
